body: Weekly TUNGSTEN_events.csv refresh done. 32 events written (Aug 17-28, 2026) covering USD/EUR/GBP/AUD/CAD -- no CHF or JPY high/med-impact releases found in this window (no SNB/BoJ decisions land Aug17-31; RBA already met Aug11, next Sept29). Highlights: CAD CPI + GBP jobs/CPI/retail sales (18-21 Aug), FOMC Minutes Wed Aug19 18:00Z, AUD employment Thu Aug20, flash PMIs Fri Aug21, German Ifo Aug25, US GDP 2nd est. + PCE/Core PCE Wed Aug26 12:30Z, Canada GDP + Jackson Hole Fed Chair keynote (Kevin Warsh, first as chair) Fri Aug28. Gaps to flag: US July Durable Goods Orders date not confirmed by Census (source only showed the Aug4 release of June data) so it was left out rather than guessed; Jackson Hole keynote time is an estimate (historical ~10am ET pattern), not a confirmed BEA/Fed-published slot. Written atomically via .tmp+rename to the live terminal's MQL4\Files\TUNGSTEN_events.csv.
